lines.zh: 铁剑拖在地上，划出一道痕。
lines.en: My iron sword drags, scoring a line in the dirt.

lines.zh: 阳光落在我肩甲上，不烫。
lines.en: Sunlight lands on my pauldron and does not burn.

lines.zh: 我沿着城墙根走，一步一步。
lines.en: I walk the base of the wall, one step at a time.
The mud on my boots is three days old.

lines.zh: 黑曜石碎屑在我脚下响。
lines.en: Obsidian grit crunches under my feet.
I cross the wheat and not a stalk stirs.
I keep walking, daylight or not.
The blade is nicked; I do not care.
My shadow stands straighter than a living man's.
Every stride measures the same.
I step around the gravestones.
Plate scrapes plate, softly.
I stand with the sword tip down.
A bird lands on my hilt, then leaves.
The sun leans west; I remember the bearing.
I have no need to find shade.
A blade of grass grows from my armor's seam.
I count the bells far off.
The wind pulls the banner taut.
I hear water dripping underground.
I do not wipe the rust from my sword.
Standing long, my knees do not creak.
The hand on your weapon shakes.
I look up and measure your shoulders.
You wear leather, not iron.
I shift the sword to my right hand.
Your shadow is short; it is noon.
I know that grip — a novice's.
You step back half a pace; I saw.
I lower my head, as if saluting.
The smell of the living: warm.
Seven paces between us.

lines.zh: 剑砍进甲缝，我退了半步。
lines.en: The blow finds my armor's seam; I give half a step.
One bone broke; no matter.
I grit my teeth; the teeth are false.
My helm is askew; I cannot see.
The blood is black and long since still.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我单膝落地。
lines.en: That blow drops me to one knee.
I prop myself up on the sword.
A dent in my plate; I will remember.
You have some skill after all.
I fall back and guard my neck.
Raise your blade and I take it as acceptance.
The taste of iron beats bread.
I do not eat; I want a fight.
Lay your sword down and I am disappointed.
One clank of armor and I turn.
A challenge draws me more than food.
I stare at your bracers.

lines.zh: 你握剑的手松了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your sword hand slackened; I noticed.
Steel flashes; I take half a step in.
This is not hunger; it is old habit.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上我的胸甲。
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my breastplate.

lines.zh: 你整个人撞上来，像撞城墙。
lines.en: You throw yourself at me like hitting a wall.
Iron meets bone with a dull knock.
We are wedged in the doorway.
I turn and yield half a foot.
You step on my blade and slip.
My plate scrapes your sleeve.
Do not push; just stand still.
The plate bears down on you; you cannot push it away.
After the knock, I straighten my helm.
The grave soil is not yet dry.
We stand side by side, unspeaking.
Her sword is a hand shorter than mine.
Two suits of armor; one is older.
We hold the same stretch of wall.
It is cold; we stand close.
The oath is in the soil, not the mouth.
She fastens my gorget for me.
We have no need of fire.
One piece of obsidian, two of us.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块黑曜石碎片。
lines.en: I pick up a shard of obsidian.
My scabbard is empty; I pick up the blade.
The dead have no use for coins.
I tuck the iron scrap into my armor.
This stone — I remember it.
I close my hand; grit bites the bone.
You should not leave a sword on the ground.
I slide the blade through my back strap.
Picking things up is an old soldier's habit.
I take only iron and stone.
Metal on metal — I heard it.

lines.zh: 枯枝断了，声音传到我耳里。
lines.en: A dry branch breaks; the sound reaches my ear.
My helm turns toward the sound.
Someone comes from the south.

lines.zh: 你的喘息穿过头盔传进来。
lines.en: Your panting comes right through my helm.
The sword tip rises on its own.
The seventh pace is when it starts.
I see the knife at your belt.

lines.zh: 你不该在白天走这条路。
lines.en: You should not walk this road by day.

lines.zh: 只来了一个人，也够我试剑。
lines.en: Only one has come — enough to test my blade.

lines.zh: 我把左脚往前挪了半寸。
lines.en: I slide my left foot forward half an inch.
No heartbeat in the armor, only wind.

lines.zh: 你驻足，我的剑停在半空。
lines.en: You halt; my sword halts in midair.
I have held this road thirty years.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我看见了剑
lines.en: You raised the torch and I saw your sword.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，像巡夜那样。
lines.en: I advance one pace at a time, like on night watch.
The sword rises to shoulder height.
Your opening is at the left ribs.
I count your breaths: the third.
The gap narrows to five paces.
I bring the blade across to guard.
You retreat; I follow.
Sun on the edge, blinding.
My heel grinds into the dirt.
You raise your shield — too late.
I have timed this step for a long while.
My resolve is cold as iron.

lines.zh: 墙在你背后，我早算好了。
lines.en: The wall is at your back; I planned that.
Only one thing remains to do.

lines.zh: 我踩着路边的石头，靠近你
lines.en: I step on the roadside stones to close in.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我的没乱
lines.en: Your steps broke rhythm; mine did not.
Four steps away, my sword can reach.

lines.zh: 我等你先出手，这是规矩
lines.en: I let you strike first; that is the rule.
The sword comes down and misses.
The edge parts your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我把全身力气压上剑柄。
lines.en: I drive my whole weight through the hilt.
You failed to block that sweep.
The iron sword is heavier than it looks.
Blood spatters my breastplate.
I reverse and cut close to the bone.
You stagger; I add a second cut.
I have practiced this cut for years.
The blade sticks in your armor.
I draw back and thrust again.
Bone gives a single crack.
Do not expect a light hand.
Ten points, and one cut is enough.

lines.zh: 剑背拍在你的肩上，很重
lines.en: The flat of my blade lands heavy on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一剑落空，我又换了个角度
lines.en: That swing missed, so I changed the angle.
Half the wall fell; I wake.
Obsidian lies cold at my feet.
It rained in the night; the soil is soft.
I climb from the grave, slowly.
The sword is still in my hand, gripped tight.
The sun is rising; I am not afraid.
I shake the dirt from my armor.
The campfire died long ago; no one guards it.
I remember which way the road runs.
First thing: find a horse.
The bell tower still stands in the distance.
I stand; my bones crack in chorus.
This grave was dug too shallow.
Daylight; the patrol begins.

lines.zh: 太阳都晒不化我，火差得远。
lines.en: The sun cannot melt me; fire is far weaker.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，甲比骨头先响。
lines.en: Falling, the armor rings before the bone.

lines.zh: 我没有气可憋，水灌进胸腔。
lines.en: I have no breath to hold; water fills my chest.
The blast throws me into the rubble.
An arrow sticks in my breastplate, wobbling.
Light sears my plate and leaves a blue mark.

lines.zh: 我早就不饿了，只是没力气。
lines.en: I stopped being hungry long ago; I have no strength.
Lightning runs the length of my iron sword.
The ground is gone; still I swing.
